verdict.rationale: Brex documents policy configuration (limits by category/role/context via budgets, spend limits, multi-level approval flows by amount/vendor/role) and AI-driven auto-approval of in-policy transactions with escalation of exceptions to humans (review agent auto-approves low-risk, escalates exceptions; audit agent flags violations by risk). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the auto-approve behavior and finer detail on category-specific policy configuration UI beyond marketing copy.
